workflow: A removal operation iterates a shared callback collection while comparing each stored entry with a user-supplied value.
The comparison invokes user code that clears and frees the collection during the iteration.
The removal operation resumes with its previous iteration state and accesses an element through the invalidated collection storage.
The stale access reads freed memory, causing a use-after-free failure and process termination.
summary: Reentrant collection clearing invalidates iteration storage
